explanation: I found no Mathlib lemma stating this result. The theorem says that change of basepoint along a path is natural with respect to the map induced by a continuous function. In Mathlib, `fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath` appears only in `Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/FundamentalGroupoid/FundamentalGroup.lean`, and that file has no lemma relating it to `FundamentalGroup.map`. The closest Mathlib result is `CategoryTheory.Functor.map_conj` (`F.map (α.conj f) = (F.mapIso α).conj (F.map f)`). This is a general fact about functors and conjugation, which counts as a structural principle here. Applying it also needs the library's own private lemma `map_pathIso`, which identifies the image of the path isomorphism under `FundamentalGroupoid.map f`, plus some unfolding. So the derivation is not a one-step instantiation of a single Mathlib result.
